rows.definition: Whole-tree fak hygiene gate (internal/hooks/gate_verbtier.go, reason VERB_UNTIERED) that refuses a dispatched cmd/fak verb whose token devindex.TierOf cannot resolve to a tier — the pre-push twin of devindex.TestVerbTierCoverageIsTotal (epic #2653).
rows.distinction: Audits the VERB-tier table (every cmd/fak dispatch verb carries a tier); distinct from gateTierDeclaredTree, which audits the LEAF/package tier (every internal/<leaf> declares a support tier). Both whole-tree hooks gates over a devindex source-of-truth; different subject table.

rows.canonical: Q4_K gate/up output slab (session-owned Metal buffer)
rows.definition: Q4KGateUpOutputSlab is the explicit session setting that reuses one bounded Metal output buffer across eligible Q4_K gate and up MLP projections within that session.
rows.distinction: This is a session-owned output-buffer reuse mechanism for two FFN projections, not gate_up_proj, the fused model weight, and not an adjudication or policy gate.
